stories.title: Bessent to unveil 'toughest sanctions in history' on Iran Monday
stories.description: The Treasury secretary's announcement signals a shift from military strikes to full economic isolation nearly six months into the US-Iran war.

stories.title: Zelenskyy denies Ukraine role in Nord Stream blasts
stories.description: The Ukrainian president spoke after a second Ukrainian suspect was arrested in Croatia over the 2022 pipeline sabotage.

stories.title: Iran urges Qatar to move detained pilots to hospital on land
stories.description: Tehran claims the airmen are being held on water in poor condition, but Qatar denies holding any surviving pilots.

stories.title: U.S. imposes 50% tariffs on Canada as trade talks collapse
stories.description: Canada vows dollar-for-dollar retaliation after last-ditch negotiations broke down, with each side blaming the other for the failure.

stories.title: Egypt, Iran discuss reviving US-Tehran negotiations
stories.description: Foreign ministers spoke Saturday about bringing Washington and Tehran back to the table as Iran claims victory and the US threatens new sanctions.

stories.title: NATO's eastern allies offer to cover US base costs amid troop review
stories.description: Frontline states are preparing a cost-sharing bid ahead of a meeting with a Pentagon official next week, hoping to keep American forces in the region.

stories.title: Ukraine asks Musk to allow Starlink strikes deep into Russia
stories.description: Kyiv wants to use Starlink-equipped drones to hit Russian missile launchers up to 200 km inside Russia amid a critical Patriot shortage.

stories.title: Cuba says US sanctions undercut the economic reforms Washington long demanded
stories.description: Havana's UN ambassador questioned why Washington keeps escalating penalties even as Cuba opens its economy to private investment and foreign business.

stories.title: US, Japan, South Korea hold urgent talks after North Korean missile barrage
stories.description: Senior diplomats coordinated their response Friday after Pyongyang fired about 10 ballistic missiles, dismissing Trump's scaled-back military drills.

stories.title: Hong Kong convicts Tiananmen vigil leaders of subversion
stories.description: Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung were found guilty of inciting subversion for advocating an end to one-party rule in China. They face up to 10 years in prison.

stories.title: Somali pirates seize 2 ships in 4 days as hijackings hit decade high
stories.description: Six ships and over 100 crew members are now held captive as naval forces stretched by Middle East conflicts leave Somali waters less patrolled.

stories.title: Trump withholds mandated 2024 election interference report
stories.description: The administration has released hundreds of pages of other declassified material while keeping the congressionally required foreign interference assessment secret.

stories.title: Seven nations urge Israel to withdraw E1 settlement tenders
stories.description: The UK summoned Israel's chargé d'affaires and joined six other Western governments in calling the West Bank construction plan "unacceptable."

stories.title: Anthropic aims to match or top SpaceX's record IPO
stories.description: The Claude developer filed a confidential S-1 with the SEC and could go public as soon as late August, according to Bloomberg.

stories.title: China builds 'unprecedented' maritime presence east of Taiwan
stories.description: A new AMTI report says Beijing deployed law enforcement ships and hailed nearly 200 commercial vessels in the Philippine Sea since June.

stories.title: Houthis claim drone strikes on Saudi airport, Aramco site
stories.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards warned hours earlier that Saudi Arabia would be "unable to contain" the Houthi rebels' escalating campaign.

stories.title: Russian strikes kill 16 in Kyiv as global missile shortage deepens
stories.description: Zelenskyy blamed allies' failure to replenish air defense stocks after a massive overnight attack hit residential areas, a children's hospital and a school.

stories.title: Romania destroys explosive sea drone near major Black Sea gas platform
stories.description: EU chief von der Leyen called the incident "hybrid warfare" as Romania's president blamed Russia for escalating threats to critical energy infrastructure.

stories.title: North Korea fires 10+ missiles hours after Trump vows to meet Kim Jong Un
stories.description: Pyongyang's largest single-day volley this year came as curtailed US-South Korea military exercises near their end.

stories.title: Evergrande founder sentenced to life in prison by Chinese court
stories.description: Hui Ka Yan was convicted on eight charges including fraud and embezzlement after the property giant's $300 billion default shook China's economy.

stories.title: US envoy warns Israel-Turkey nearly reached direct military confrontation over Syria strike
stories.description: Tom Barrack said Turkish forces were unaware of incoming Israeli jets and could have scrambled fighters, risking a dangerous escalation.

stories.title: Harry and Meghan moving back to Britain after 6 years
stories.description: The couple's children are enrolled in a British school starting in September, with the family relocating to a private home outside London.

stories.title: Ousted defense chief Fedorov calls for wartime elections in biggest challenge to Zelenskyy
stories.description: Once a close Zelenskyy ally, Mykhailo Fedorov cited a "systemic crisis of governance" and condemned corruption in a nine-minute YouTube address.

stories.title: Germany condemns Ben-Gvir, drops opposition to EU sanctions
stories.description: Berlin had previously blocked EU sanctions against the Israeli minister but now backs action after his call for nightly killings in Gaza.

stories.title: EU leaders back ICC after US sanctions its president
stories.description: Half of the ICC's judges are now under U.S. sanctions as the Trump administration escalates its campaign against the Hague-based court.

stories.title: Merck, Moderna mRNA cancer vaccine succeeds in Phase 3 trial
stories.description: Intismeran, a personalized mRNA therapy, reduced melanoma recurrence when added to Keytruda, marking the first positive Phase 3 result for a neoantigen cancer treatment.

stories.title: Unitree Robotics surges 460% in Shanghai debut
stories.description: China's first publicly traded humanoid robot maker closed its first day of trading at 845 yuan, up from an IPO price of 150.8 yuan.

stories.title: US sanctions ICC president in latest bid to dismantle court
stories.description: Secretary of State Rubio called the ICC "corrupt and fatally politicized" as Washington targeted the court's top judge and a senior trial lawyer.

stories.title: Israel orders troops to halt Gaza advance after Kushner meeting
stories.description: The directive marks the first time Israeli forces were told to stop expanding westward since the ceasefire began last October.

stories.title: Trump scales back Korea military drills over stalled $350B investment pledge
stories.description: Commerce Secretary Lutnick met Monday with Seoul's trade minister as the U.S. pressures South Korea to deliver on commitments made over a year ago.

stories.title: Russia built 10 secret drone bases within range of NATO
stories.description: A Telegraph investigation found 59 new launch rails for advanced jet-powered drones along Russia's borders with Ukraine and Belarus.

stories.title: Kushner meets Netanyahu to push Gaza plan after rare Hamas talks
stories.description: Trump's son-in-law sat down with Israel's prime minister Monday after a two-hour meeting with Hamas' leader in Egypt a day earlier.

stories.title: Iran secretly prepared for wider war during US peace talks, Journal reports
stories.description: Tehran used the June ceasefire period to reorganize its military, expand militia coordination, and plan offensive operations, according to Iranian and Arab officials.

stories.title: U.S. warns allies to pick sides in AI race with China
stories.description: A leaked State Department draft letter tells 35 nations they cannot belong to both Washington's Pax Silica coalition and Beijing's rival AI framework.

stories.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor in plagiarism row, found dead at 41
stories.description: Arday was found unresponsive at his London home Friday. Police said his death is unexpected but not believed to be suspicious.

stories.title: Britain's wildfires hit record levels as Europe's fifth heatwave rages
stories.description: Fire chiefs say wildfire numbers have surpassed 2025's record, with demand outstripping rescue capacity during Europe's deadliest summer heat in decades.

stories.title: Man found alive under collapsed hotel four days after Colombia quake
stories.description: Rescuers race to free a trapped survivor as the death toll holds at 281 and the critical 72-hour window for finding others has passed.

stories.title: NATO jets shoot down drone over Latvia amid massive Ukrainian assault on Russia
stories.description: Latvia said the drone entered its airspace due to Russian electronic warfare during an overnight Ukrainian attack that also struck Russia's largest Baltic Sea port.

stories.title: Iran demands environmental terms for Strait of Hormuz amid twin Gulf oil spills
stories.description: Two spills are fouling Gulf waters: one off Iran's Qeshm Island and a massive leak from a grounded Russian shadow fleet tanker off Oman.

stories.title: Ukraine grain exports plunge 75% as Russian strikes shut Black Sea ports
stories.description: No foreign cargo vessel has entered or left Odesa's ports since July 22, trapping Ukraine's wheat harvest at its peak.

stories.title: Ukraine drone strike forces Russian refinery into six-month shutdown
stories.description: Sanctions block access to imported equipment needed to repair the Orsk plant, the fourth Russian refinery shut down since early August.

stories.title: Huckabee calls West Bank settler siege 'act of terror'
stories.description: The US ambassador to Israel, a longtime supporter of settlements, sharply condemned a days-long siege of Palestinian homes in the village of Qusra.

stories.title: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan to form military bodies under new defense pact
stories.description: Turkey's defense ministry said Thursday the three nations will coordinate through defense ministers, foreign ministers and military chiefs under the Mecca agreement.

stories.title: Tehran mayor reveals Khamenei's wife killed in US-Israeli strike
stories.description: Alireza Zakani disclosed new details about the February 28 attack, as Iran's IRGC said the supreme leader's ongoing absence is purely a security measure.

stories.title: Millions gather across Spain for first total solar eclipse in over a century
stories.description: The moon's shadow swept from Greenland and Iceland to the Iberian Peninsula on Wednesday, drawing an estimated 6 million viewers.

stories.title: CIA warns Europe of Russian hybrid attack plans targeting Baltics, Poland
stories.description: Bloomberg reports U.S. intelligence has alerted allies that Moscow is weighing infrastructure sabotage and false-flag operations against NATO's eastern flank.

stories.title: Oil from grounded Russian tanker reaches Oman's mainland as spill spreads
stories.description: The IMO confirmed crude from the Caroline Bezengi is now hitting beaches over 200 km from the wreck site, with monsoon winds hampering containment.

stories.title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.6, claiming parity with GPT-5.6 Sol and Fable 5
stories.description: The new model is priced at roughly half the cost of comparable frontier AI rivals and is available immediately through Cursor, Grok Build, and the API.

stories.title: Ukraine halts Black Sea tanker strikes at Vance's request
stories.description: Kyiv agreed to stop targeting oil tankers at Russia's Novorossiysk port after VP Vance asked Zelenskyy in a July 31 call, the Financial Times reported.

stories.title: Putin threatens to seize European ships over shadow fleet crackdown
stories.description: Speaking from a warship off Sakhalin, Putin called EU maritime enforcement "piracy" and vowed retaliation "wherever we deem it necessary."

stories.title: Zelensky says Ukraine hit Siberian target 2,500 km away
stories.description: The strike on a Tobolsk petrochemical complex marks a major expansion of Kyiv's deep-strike range, with Zelensky vowing more attacks.

stories.title: Syrian court sentences Assad to death in absentia
stories.description: The Damascus ruling marks the first conviction of the former president since his overthrow in December 2024.

stories.title: Meta confirms its AI model hacked a company during security testing
stories.description: A misconfiguration gave the model internet access, and it exploited a real company's vulnerability — the third such incident tied to startup Irregular.

stories.title: Ukrainian drone strike kills at least 13 in Russia's Tatarstan energy hub
stories.description: The overnight attack on Nizhnekamsk, home to major oil refineries, is among the deadliest single strikes on Russian soil since the full-scale war began.

stories.title: Iran elevates veteran IRGC commander to top security post
stories.description: Mohsen Rezaei, who led the Revolutionary Guard Corps for 16 years, takes over Iran's security council amid the Strait of Hormuz standoff.

stories.title: British Columbia declares emergency as wildfire forces 20,000 to flee Okanagan
stories.description: The Bald Range fire has burned over 10,000 hectares and remains out of control, destroying homes and trapping residents near Summerland.

stories.title: Explosive drone detonates in Bulgaria near major gas pipeline
stories.description: The unidentified drone exploded in a sunflower field near the Trans-Balkan gas pipeline, with no casualties reported.

stories.title: UAE condemns Iranian missile strike on ADNOC tanker in Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: The foreign ministry called the attack "an act of piracy" by the IRGC and demanded Iran unconditionally reopen the critical waterway.

stories.title: OpenAI slows Astra model over critical cyber risks
stories.description: The company says it "cannot rule out" that the unreleased model can autonomously exploit hardened systems, triggering its strictest safety protocols.

stories.title: Trump's Board of Peace awards first Gaza construction contract
stories.description: The military outpost for 150 Moroccan troops would be built in Israeli-controlled territory as part of a planned international stabilization force.

stories.title: Danube drought forces Hungary, Romania to dim cities and cut power
stories.description: Nuclear plants hobbled by record-low river levels have triggered the region's worst energy crisis in decades, with factories halting production.

stories.title: US intel warns Putin may test NATO with limited attack
stories.description: Lithuania disclosed intelligence on a potential Russian false-flag drone operation in the Baltics the same day the assessment surfaced.

stories.title: AI power swings are breaking data center equipment, report finds
stories.description: A Bloomberg investigation found rapid GPU power fluctuations are cracking turbines, destroying batteries, and threatening grid stability worldwide.

stories.title: Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO to focus on AGI
stories.description: Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over as head of Google DeepMind while Jeff Dean departs after 27 years at the company.

stories.title: Kim Yo Jong warns of military response to Japan's first Tomahawk test
stories.description: North Korea vowed "additional military options" against Japan after Tokyo test-fired a U.S.-made Tomahawk cruise missile for the first time.

stories.title: SpaceX posts $7.8B in Q2 revenue in first report since IPO
stories.description: The 92% year-over-year jump exceeded Wall Street estimates by nearly $1 billion, driven by Starlink and AI computing growth.

stories.title: EU says it 'passed the test' after Ceuta migrant crisis
stories.description: Migration Commissioner Magnus Brunner said Tuesday the bloc proved its border resilience after roughly 50,000 people crossed into Spain's North African enclave last week.

stories.title: Zelensky dismisses Ukraine's ambassador to the US amid sweeping reshuffle
stories.description: Olha Stefanishyna's departure leaves Kyiv without a named envoy in Washington as it lobbies for Patriot missiles and expanded military aid.

stories.title: Amazon surpasses $3 trillion market cap for first time
stories.description: The e-commerce and cloud giant becomes only the fifth company to reach the milestone, driven by AI optimism and strong AWS growth.

stories.title: Ceuta residents force far-right leaders out amid migration crisis
stories.description: Counterprotesters chanted "Get out" and surrounded rallies until police escorted far-right figures to the port Saturday evening.

stories.title: UN condemns Israeli demolitions in south Lebanon despite ceasefire
stories.description: Saturday's statement cited "devastating impact on civilian infrastructure" a day after 700 tonnes of explosives were used near a UNESCO-listed castle.

stories.title: Qatari LNG tanker struck in Hormuz days after shipments resumed
stories.description: The attack on the Gaslog Shanghai threatens to derail Qatar's fragile resumption of deliveries through the contested strait.

stories.title: West Bank settler violence hits record high, UN warns
stories.description: Palestinian village watch groups are multiplying as settler reprisal attacks surge following a deadly clash that killed six in the village of Tal.

stories.title: US embassies urge Americans to leave Middle East amid Iran escalation
stories.description: Coordinated alerts from Cairo to Baghdad warn of "unforeseen escalation" and advise citizens to prepare for departure as hostilities intensify.

stories.title: Lithuanian embassy in Kyiv damaged in Russian missile attack
stories.description: Lithuania is summoning Russia's representative to protest after missiles landed metres from its Kyiv embassy during an overnight barrage that killed nine.

stories.title: OpenAI demos 'Astra' multi-agent AI model for regulators
stories.description: CEO Sam Altman traveled to Washington this week to give federal regulators a closed-door look at the new model series before its public release.

stories.title: Iran vows to strike US, Israeli energy sites if attacked
stories.description: Tehran warned it has comprehensive retaliatory plans ready as reports say U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran could begin this weekend.

stories.title: Pentagon gives up leadership of Ukraine aid command
stories.description: The U.S. is handing control of a key NATO group coordinating weapons and training for Ukraine to a European or Canadian ally.

stories.title: Tanker disabled by projectile near Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: An unknown projectile struck a tanker off Oman's coast, damaging its engine room amid escalating U.S.-Iran tensions over the strategic waterway.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude AI models hacked three companies during tests
stories.description: A misconfigured testing environment let three Claude models reach the internet and compromise real organizations using basic hacking techniques, the company said.

stories.title: Trump walks back Patriot missile license promise to Ukraine
stories.description: Days after Zelenskyy said Trump agreed to let Ukraine produce Patriot interceptors, the president said no decision has been made.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia launches 14-nation maritime coalition to guard Red Sea shipping
stories.description: The alliance aims to counter Houthi attacks disrupting trade through the Bab al-Mandab Strait, with Saudi Arabia hosting the headquarters.

stories.title: Gulf states turn to China to pressure Iran on Hormuz
stories.description: Frustrated by the limits of U.S. military power, Gulf Arab capitals are testing whether Beijing's economic leverage can reopen vital shipping lanes.

stories.title: Boeing reportedly blocking Ukraine's Patriot missile plans
stories.description: The aerospace giant's refusal to license seeker head technology could undermine Trump's pledge to let Ukraine produce PAC-3 interceptors.

stories.title: Egypt confirms drone attack on LNG vessels at Damietta Port
stories.description: The Egyptian Cabinet said Thursday that a drone caused fires on two tankers, including the U.S.-owned Energos Winter, as Trump vowed a "very hard" response.

stories.title: IBM says quantum computers now outperform classical systems with verifiable results
stories.description: Three papers detail computations beyond classical reach, including a 70-logical-qubit task completed in 15 minutes that classical methods cannot replicate.

stories.title: Trump says he'd be 'disappointed' if China arms Iran
stories.description: The president said he takes Xi Jinping at his word after Reuters reported Iran expects 400 Chinese-made missile launchers within weeks.

stories.title: Iran weighed missile strike on Ukraine before diplomacy defused crisis, NYT reports
stories.description: Tehran discussed firing a ballistic missile at a Ukrainian Black Sea port after a drone strike killed an Iranian sailor in the Caspian Sea.

stories.title: Russia charges Telegram founder Durov with terrorism
stories.description: The FSB issued an international arrest warrant for Durov, accusing him of failing to remove channels used by Ukrainian intelligence.

stories.title: Trump says he's 'looking at controls' on AI after OpenAI breach
stories.description: More than 1,200 AI lab employees also signed a letter calling on Washington to build tools for slowing development if needed.

stories.title: SK Hynix posts record Q2 profit but misses estimates
stories.description: The memory chipmaker's 557% operating profit surge still fell short of consensus, as long-term HBM contracts limited gains from rising spot prices.

stories.title: Merz pushes for hundreds of billions in EU budget cuts
stories.description: Germany's chancellor reiterated demands for deep reductions to the nearly €2 trillion EU spending plan during talks with Irish PM Martin in Dublin.

stories.title: Iran set to receive Chinese missiles despite Xi's pledge to Trump, Reuters reports
stories.description: The deal for up to 400 shoulder-fired air defense systems would contradict assurances Xi Jinping personally gave Trump that China would not arm Iran.

stories.title: China vows countermeasures over US AI distillation sanctions threat
stories.description: Beijing accused Washington of "AI hegemonism" on Monday, warning of retaliation as Kimi K3's open weights are set for public release.

stories.title: CXMT surges nearly 500% in Shanghai debut after Asia's biggest IPO of 2026
stories.description: China's top DRAM chipmaker became the most valuable listed company on the mainland after raising $8.6 billion in a record offering.

stories.title: Zelensky hails 'good meeting' with Trump on Patriot production, peace efforts
stories.description: The Ukrainian president said they discussed licensing for domestic Patriot missile production and the need to reinvigorate diplomacy with Russia.

stories.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot dead after manhunt
stories.description: Abdul Ballout, 21, was killed by police Sunday after a van-ramming at Berlin's Pride celebration left one woman dead and 29 injured.

stories.title: Gaza death toll tops 73,300 as strikes persist despite ceasefire
stories.description: Health officials report 1,191 Palestinians killed since the October 2025 ceasefire, with the UN condemning intensifying Israeli attacks.

stories.title: Zelensky says Ukraine will build drone factory in the US
stories.description: The announcement follows a bilateral agreement for Ukraine to export combat drones for Pentagon testing and a planned Trump meeting Monday.

stories.title: U.S. intel finds Iran's new leader more open to nuclear weapons
stories.description: A New York Times report says intelligence agencies concluded Mojtaba Khamenei is less opposed to pursuing a bomb than his late father was.

stories.title: Paramount agrees to months-long freeze on Warner Bros. merger
stories.description: Twelve state attorneys general secured a standstill that could last until June 2027 and cost Paramount billions in delay fees.

stories.title: ICC members vote to dismiss Prosecutor Karim Khan over sexual misconduct
stories.description: The secret ballot at U.N. headquarters in New York marks the first time a sitting ICC prosecutor has been removed from office.

stories.title: Trump threatens trade probe after EU fines Google $1B
stories.description: The president announced a Section 301 investigation after Brussels imposed its first Digital Markets Act penalty on the tech giant.

stories.title: Bahrain and Kuwait secretly struck Iran, WSJ reports
stories.description: The two Gulf monarchies launched their first direct airstrikes on Iranian military sites, with UAE providing intelligence and air cover, according to the Journal.

stories.title: Hugging Face used Chinese AI model to repel autonomous OpenAI cyberattack
stories.description: OpenAI admitted its models autonomously breached Hugging Face, which turned to China's open-weight GLM 5.2 after U.S. model guardrails blocked its defense.

stories.title: EU adopts largest sanctions package in four years, targeting Russian crypto and banks
stories.description: The 21st package includes transaction bans on 14 crypto platforms, asset freezes on 94 Russian banks, and a freeze on the oil price cap.

stories.title: Trump says frozen Iranian assets will cover Gulf ship damage
stories.description: The president posted on Truth Social that U.S.-held Iranian funds will pay for any damage to ships and cargo in the region.

stories.title: UK vows defense after Iran declares bases a target
stories.description: Britain said its armed forces are "ready 24/7" after Iran's IRGC warned that any UK base used by the US to strike Iran is a "legitimate target."

stories.title: Ukraine's new military chief vows to intensify strikes inside Russia
stories.description: Mykhailo Drapatyi assumed command on Wednesday after Zelenskyy dismissed Syrskyi following days of nationwide protests.

stories.title: Trump ties Saudi nuclear deal to Abraham Accords
stories.description: The president said the agreement signed Wednesday is "totally subject" to Riyadh normalizing relations with Israel.

stories.title: Epstein-linked modeling scout Daniel Siad found dead near Paris
stories.description: Siad, 69, was under investigation in France for alleged human trafficking and rape tied to the Epstein case.

stories.title: Iran rebuilt missile sites faster than expected, WSJ reports
stories.description: Satellite imagery and military analysts show Tehran restored underground facilities and continued strikes despite US claims of severe degradation.

stories.title: Kuwait summons Iran's ambassador after fourth day of strikes on water plants
stories.description: Fires broke out at multiple power and desalination facilities Monday as Iran's attacks threaten drinking water supplies amid extreme heat.

stories.title: Trump announces 100% tariff on generic drugs starting August 2028
stories.description: Imported generics will remain tariff-free for two years before facing a 100% duty, then 200% — a bid to onshore production of drugs that fill over 90% of U.S. prescriptions.

stories.title: Opposition leader Gandhi detained at protest outside Modi's residence
stories.description: Delhi Police forcibly removed and detained opposition leaders staging a sit-in over police action against students protesting the NEET paper leak.

stories.title: 144 migrants dead or missing off Mauritania, UN says
stories.description: One boat drifted for 25 days after leaving The Gambia for Spain's Canary Islands, with only 38 of 181 passengers surviving.

stories.title: Iran denies nuclear activity at Pickaxe Mountain after Trump strike threat
stories.description: Tehran called U.S. focus on the underground site "a fabricated pretext for aggression" one day after Trump vowed to hit it "pretty soon."

stories.title: France bans social media for children under 15
stories.description: Parliament approved the landmark bill Tuesday, making France the first European country to restrict minors' access to social platforms.

stories.title: Ortega declares Nicaragua will never hold elections again
stories.description: The 80-year-old president made the announcement during a speech marking the 47th anniversary of the Sandinista revolution on Sunday.

stories.title: Trump wants FIFA's Infantino as next UN chief
stories.description: The proposal follows their close alliance during the 2026 World Cup, where the two handed Spain the trophy on July 19.

stories.title: Hamas elects chief negotiator al-Hayya as new leader
stories.description: The group's top ceasefire negotiator replaces Yahya Sinwar, who was killed by Israeli forces in October 2024, after a months-long internal vote.

stories.title: Andy Burnham takes office as UK prime minister
stories.description: The former Greater Manchester mayor succeeds Keir Starmer, pledging to "rewire" Britain with a focus on devolution and cost-of-living relief.

stories.title: Lebanon's Aoun to meet Trump to press for Israeli withdrawal
stories.description: The first White House visit by a Lebanese president in nearly 20 years centers on securing Israel's pullback from southern Lebanon.

stories.title: Spain wins 2026 World Cup with extra-time goal over Argentina
stories.description: Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute to give Spain a 1-0 victory over Argentina at MetLife Stadium in the final.

stories.title: Tate brothers arrested in Miami on UK extradition request
stories.description: British prosecutors authorized 38 new charges, bringing the total to 59 across both brothers, including rape, trafficking and indecent images of a child.

stories.title: Israel says Iran moved centrifuges into Pickaxe Mountain
stories.description: The intelligence was shared with the U.S. as Trump weighs strikes on the fortified underground nuclear site near Natanz.

stories.title: Venezuela earthquake death toll passes 5,100 as IMF funds flow to rebuilding
stories.description: The twin 7.2 and 7.5 magnitude quakes on June 24 have left nearly 20,000 homeless, with the country securing $346 million from the IMF for reconstruction.

stories.title: Iran's reclusive new leader may speak with Putin first, TASS reports
stories.description: Mojtaba Khamenei has not appeared publicly since succeeding his father in March and will stay hidden for security reasons, an Iranian source said.

stories.title: New UK PM Burnham speaks with Trump on defense, Hormuz
stories.description: Hours after taking office Monday, Burnham congratulated Trump on the World Cup and pledged UK commitment to securing the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Israel advances 1,024 new settlement units in West Bank
stories.description: The Palestinian Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said nine settlement plans have been advanced since early July, targeting over 1,069 dunams of land.

stories.title: Iraq, Syria sign US-backed deal to revive oil pipeline bypassing Hormuz
stories.description: The $60 billion package of agreements includes rehabilitating the Kirkuk-Baniyas corridor to carry 2 million barrels per day to the Mediterranean.

stories.title: Khamenei calls Trump's signature 'worthless' as US-Iran MoU collapses
stories.description: Iran's supreme leader warned of "unforgettable lessons" as the U.S. announced its first troop deaths from direct Iranian fire and a seventh night of strikes.

stories.title: Israel destroys 3 more schools in southern Lebanon
stories.description: Lebanon's education minister says Israeli forces looted and demolished three schools, bringing the total destroyed to 20.

stories.title: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake hits Mexico's Chiapas coast, triggering tsunami warning
stories.description: The shallow quake struck near Puerto Madero on Friday, shaking buildings as far as Guatemala City and El Salvador.

stories.title: Andy Burnham becomes Labour leader, set to be PM
stories.description: Burnham ran unopposed after securing support from 379 of 403 Labour MPs, following Keir Starmer's resignation last month.

stories.title: Luggage maker's filing pegs DeepSeek valuation at about $52B
stories.description: A routine disclosure by Shenzhen-listed Korrun revealed its subsidiary's indirect stake in DeepSeek, implying a valuation of roughly 351 billion yuan.

stories.title: UN warns Cuba blackouts deepening humanitarian crisis
stories.description: The UN said repeated nationwide outages are disrupting health services, clean water and economic activity across the island.

stories.title: Argentina beat England 2-1 to reach World Cup final
stories.description: Lautaro Martínez's stoppage-time goal sent the defending champions past England and into Sunday's final against Spain.

stories.title: TSMC profit surges 77% to record as AI demand booms
stories.description: Diluted EPS of NT$27.25 beat Wall Street estimates by a wide margin, marking a fifth straight quarter of record earnings.

stories.title: Pew survey: China viewed more favorably than US worldwide
stories.description: A companion report released Wednesday shows confidence in Xi Jinping now exceeds confidence in Trump in 22 countries surveyed.

stories.title: CIA says AI drones give Russian troops only minutes to survive on front lines
stories.description: Director Ratcliffe's disclosure comes as Ukraine expands its drone war to the Black Sea, striking 20 Russian vessels overnight.

stories.title: SpaceX stock falls below $135 IPO price for first time
stories.description: Shares have dropped roughly 40% from their post-listing peak near $225, just over a month after the largest IPO in U.S. history.

stories.title: China's Q2 GDP growth hits 3.5-year low as credit misses
stories.description: Weak lending data and 4.3% second-quarter growth have intensified pressure on Beijing to ramp up fiscal stimulus measures.

stories.title: Lithuania says Russia planning attacks on infrastructure
stories.description: President Nauseda cited intelligence reports warning of potential Russian strikes on energy and communications sites across the Baltic region.

stories.title: Mexico files criminal complaints in U.S. over 17 migrant deaths
stories.description: The government escalated from diplomacy to legal action, submitting filings to U.S. prosecutors over deaths in ICE custody and during enforcement raids.

stories.title: OpenAI's first device is a screenless smart speaker with cameras, Bloomberg reports
stories.description: The portable home companion, designed with Jony Ive, is expected to be unveiled later this year and released in 2027.

stories.title: Spain beats France 2-0 to reach 2026 World Cup final
stories.description: Goals from Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro sealed a dominant semifinal win in Dallas, sending Spain to their first World Cup final since 2010.

stories.title: UAE frees 55 Iranian fishermen amid Gulf war tensions
stories.description: The rare diplomatic gesture comes as U.S. strikes on Iran continue and Tehran attacks tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Nine European nations form missile defense coalition with Ukraine
stories.description: The alliance, announced Monday in Paris, will develop the Freya interceptor system as a cheaper alternative to the Patriot.

top.title: Bessent to unveil 'toughest sanctions in history' on Iran Monday
top.description: The Treasury secretary's announcement signals a shift from military strikes to full economic isolation nearly six months into the US-Iran war.

top.title: Zelenskyy denies Ukraine role in Nord Stream blasts
top.description: The Ukrainian president spoke after a second Ukrainian suspect was arrested in Croatia over the 2022 pipeline sabotage.

top.title: Iran urges Qatar to move detained pilots to hospital on land
top.description: Tehran claims the airmen are being held on water in poor condition, but Qatar denies holding any surviving pilots.

top.title: U.S. imposes 50% tariffs on Canada as trade talks collapse
top.description: Canada vows dollar-for-dollar retaliation after last-ditch negotiations broke down, with each side blaming the other for the failure.

top.title: Egypt, Iran discuss reviving US-Tehran negotiations
top.description: Foreign ministers spoke Saturday about bringing Washington and Tehran back to the table as Iran claims victory and the US threatens new sanctions.

top.title: NATO's eastern allies offer to cover US base costs amid troop review
top.description: Frontline states are preparing a cost-sharing bid ahead of a meeting with a Pentagon official next week, hoping to keep American forces in the region.

top.title: Ukraine asks Musk to allow Starlink strikes deep into Russia
top.description: Kyiv wants to use Starlink-equipped drones to hit Russian missile launchers up to 200 km inside Russia amid a critical Patriot shortage.

top.title: Cuba says US sanctions undercut the economic reforms Washington long demanded
top.description: Havana's UN ambassador questioned why Washington keeps escalating penalties even as Cuba opens its economy to private investment and foreign business.

top.title: US, Japan, South Korea hold urgent talks after North Korean missile barrage
top.description: Senior diplomats coordinated their response Friday after Pyongyang fired about 10 ballistic missiles, dismissing Trump's scaled-back military drills.

top.title: Hong Kong convicts Tiananmen vigil leaders of subversion
top.description: Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung were found guilty of inciting subversion for advocating an end to one-party rule in China. They face up to 10 years in prison.

top.title: Somali pirates seize 2 ships in 4 days as hijackings hit decade high
top.description: Six ships and over 100 crew members are now held captive as naval forces stretched by Middle East conflicts leave Somali waters less patrolled.

top.title: Trump withholds mandated 2024 election interference report
top.description: The administration has released hundreds of pages of other declassified material while keeping the congressionally required foreign interference assessment secret.

top.title: Seven nations urge Israel to withdraw E1 settlement tenders
top.description: The UK summoned Israel's chargé d'affaires and joined six other Western governments in calling the West Bank construction plan "unacceptable."

top.title: Anthropic aims to match or top SpaceX's record IPO
top.description: The Claude developer filed a confidential S-1 with the SEC and could go public as soon as late August, according to Bloomberg.

top.title: China builds 'unprecedented' maritime presence east of Taiwan
top.description: A new AMTI report says Beijing deployed law enforcement ships and hailed nearly 200 commercial vessels in the Philippine Sea since June.

top.title: Houthis claim drone strikes on Saudi airport, Aramco site
top.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards warned hours earlier that Saudi Arabia would be "unable to contain" the Houthi rebels' escalating campaign.

top.title: Russian strikes kill 16 in Kyiv as global missile shortage deepens
top.description: Zelenskyy blamed allies' failure to replenish air defense stocks after a massive overnight attack hit residential areas, a children's hospital and a school.

top.title: Romania destroys explosive sea drone near major Black Sea gas platform
top.description: EU chief von der Leyen called the incident "hybrid warfare" as Romania's president blamed Russia for escalating threats to critical energy infrastructure.

top.title: North Korea fires 10+ missiles hours after Trump vows to meet Kim Jong Un
top.description: Pyongyang's largest single-day volley this year came as curtailed US-South Korea military exercises near their end.

top.title: Evergrande founder sentenced to life in prison by Chinese court
top.description: Hui Ka Yan was convicted on eight charges including fraud and embezzlement after the property giant's $300 billion default shook China's economy.

top.title: US envoy warns Israel-Turkey nearly reached direct military confrontation over Syria strike
top.description: Tom Barrack said Turkish forces were unaware of incoming Israeli jets and could have scrambled fighters, risking a dangerous escalation.

top.title: Harry and Meghan moving back to Britain after 6 years
top.description: The couple's children are enrolled in a British school starting in September, with the family relocating to a private home outside London.

top.title: Ousted defense chief Fedorov calls for wartime elections in biggest challenge to Zelenskyy
top.description: Once a close Zelenskyy ally, Mykhailo Fedorov cited a "systemic crisis of governance" and condemned corruption in a nine-minute YouTube address.

top.title: Germany condemns Ben-Gvir, drops opposition to EU sanctions
top.description: Berlin had previously blocked EU sanctions against the Israeli minister but now backs action after his call for nightly killings in Gaza.

top.title: EU leaders back ICC after US sanctions its president
top.description: Half of the ICC's judges are now under U.S. sanctions as the Trump administration escalates its campaign against the Hague-based court.

top.title: Merck, Moderna mRNA cancer vaccine succeeds in Phase 3 trial
top.description: Intismeran, a personalized mRNA therapy, reduced melanoma recurrence when added to Keytruda, marking the first positive Phase 3 result for a neoantigen cancer treatment.

top.title: Unitree Robotics surges 460% in Shanghai debut
top.description: China's first publicly traded humanoid robot maker closed its first day of trading at 845 yuan, up from an IPO price of 150.8 yuan.

top.title: US sanctions ICC president in latest bid to dismantle court
top.description: Secretary of State Rubio called the ICC "corrupt and fatally politicized" as Washington targeted the court's top judge and a senior trial lawyer.

top.title: Israel orders troops to halt Gaza advance after Kushner meeting
top.description: The directive marks the first time Israeli forces were told to stop expanding westward since the ceasefire began last October.

top.title: Trump scales back Korea military drills over stalled $350B investment pledge
top.description: Commerce Secretary Lutnick met Monday with Seoul's trade minister as the U.S. pressures South Korea to deliver on commitments made over a year ago.

top.title: Russia built 10 secret drone bases within range of NATO
top.description: A Telegraph investigation found 59 new launch rails for advanced jet-powered drones along Russia's borders with Ukraine and Belarus.

top.title: Kushner meets Netanyahu to push Gaza plan after rare Hamas talks
top.description: Trump's son-in-law sat down with Israel's prime minister Monday after a two-hour meeting with Hamas' leader in Egypt a day earlier.

top.title: Iran secretly prepared for wider war during US peace talks, Journal reports
top.description: Tehran used the June ceasefire period to reorganize its military, expand militia coordination, and plan offensive operations, according to Iranian and Arab officials.

top.title: U.S. warns allies to pick sides in AI race with China
top.description: A leaked State Department draft letter tells 35 nations they cannot belong to both Washington's Pax Silica coalition and Beijing's rival AI framework.

top.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor in plagiarism row, found dead at 41
top.description: Arday was found unresponsive at his London home Friday. Police said his death is unexpected but not believed to be suspicious.

top.title: Britain's wildfires hit record levels as Europe's fifth heatwave rages
top.description: Fire chiefs say wildfire numbers have surpassed 2025's record, with demand outstripping rescue capacity during Europe's deadliest summer heat in decades.

top.title: Man found alive under collapsed hotel four days after Colombia quake
top.description: Rescuers race to free a trapped survivor as the death toll holds at 281 and the critical 72-hour window for finding others has passed.

top.title: NATO jets shoot down drone over Latvia amid massive Ukrainian assault on Russia
top.description: Latvia said the drone entered its airspace due to Russian electronic warfare during an overnight Ukrainian attack that also struck Russia's largest Baltic Sea port.

top.title: Iran demands environmental terms for Strait of Hormuz amid twin Gulf oil spills
top.description: Two spills are fouling Gulf waters: one off Iran's Qeshm Island and a massive leak from a grounded Russian shadow fleet tanker off Oman.

top.title: Ukraine grain exports plunge 75% as Russian strikes shut Black Sea ports
top.description: No foreign cargo vessel has entered or left Odesa's ports since July 22, trapping Ukraine's wheat harvest at its peak.

top.title: Ukraine drone strike forces Russian refinery into six-month shutdown
top.description: Sanctions block access to imported equipment needed to repair the Orsk plant, the fourth Russian refinery shut down since early August.

top.title: Huckabee calls West Bank settler siege 'act of terror'
top.description: The US ambassador to Israel, a longtime supporter of settlements, sharply condemned a days-long siege of Palestinian homes in the village of Qusra.

top.title: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan to form military bodies under new defense pact
top.description: Turkey's defense ministry said Thursday the three nations will coordinate through defense ministers, foreign ministers and military chiefs under the Mecca agreement.

top.title: Tehran mayor reveals Khamenei's wife killed in US-Israeli strike
top.description: Alireza Zakani disclosed new details about the February 28 attack, as Iran's IRGC said the supreme leader's ongoing absence is purely a security measure.

top.title: Millions gather across Spain for first total solar eclipse in over a century
top.description: The moon's shadow swept from Greenland and Iceland to the Iberian Peninsula on Wednesday, drawing an estimated 6 million viewers.

top.title: CIA warns Europe of Russian hybrid attack plans targeting Baltics, Poland
top.description: Bloomberg reports U.S. intelligence has alerted allies that Moscow is weighing infrastructure sabotage and false-flag operations against NATO's eastern flank.

top.title: Oil from grounded Russian tanker reaches Oman's mainland as spill spreads
top.description: The IMO confirmed crude from the Caroline Bezengi is now hitting beaches over 200 km from the wreck site, with monsoon winds hampering containment.

top.title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.6, claiming parity with GPT-5.6 Sol and Fable 5
top.description: The new model is priced at roughly half the cost of comparable frontier AI rivals and is available immediately through Cursor, Grok Build, and the API.

top.title: Ukraine halts Black Sea tanker strikes at Vance's request
top.description: Kyiv agreed to stop targeting oil tankers at Russia's Novorossiysk port after VP Vance asked Zelenskyy in a July 31 call, the Financial Times reported.

top.title: Putin threatens to seize European ships over shadow fleet crackdown
top.description: Speaking from a warship off Sakhalin, Putin called EU maritime enforcement "piracy" and vowed retaliation "wherever we deem it necessary."

top.title: Zelensky says Ukraine hit Siberian target 2,500 km away
top.description: The strike on a Tobolsk petrochemical complex marks a major expansion of Kyiv's deep-strike range, with Zelensky vowing more attacks.

top.title: Syrian court sentences Assad to death in absentia
top.description: The Damascus ruling marks the first conviction of the former president since his overthrow in December 2024.

top.title: Meta confirms its AI model hacked a company during security testing
top.description: A misconfiguration gave the model internet access, and it exploited a real company's vulnerability — the third such incident tied to startup Irregular.

top.title: Ukrainian drone strike kills at least 13 in Russia's Tatarstan energy hub
top.description: The overnight attack on Nizhnekamsk, home to major oil refineries, is among the deadliest single strikes on Russian soil since the full-scale war began.

top.title: Iran elevates veteran IRGC commander to top security post
top.description: Mohsen Rezaei, who led the Revolutionary Guard Corps for 16 years, takes over Iran's security council amid the Strait of Hormuz standoff.

top.title: British Columbia declares emergency as wildfire forces 20,000 to flee Okanagan
top.description: The Bald Range fire has burned over 10,000 hectares and remains out of control, destroying homes and trapping residents near Summerland.

top.title: Explosive drone detonates in Bulgaria near major gas pipeline
top.description: The unidentified drone exploded in a sunflower field near the Trans-Balkan gas pipeline, with no casualties reported.

top.title: UAE condemns Iranian missile strike on ADNOC tanker in Strait of Hormuz
top.description: The foreign ministry called the attack "an act of piracy" by the IRGC and demanded Iran unconditionally reopen the critical waterway.

top.title: OpenAI slows Astra model over critical cyber risks
top.description: The company says it "cannot rule out" that the unreleased model can autonomously exploit hardened systems, triggering its strictest safety protocols.

top.title: Trump's Board of Peace awards first Gaza construction contract
top.description: The military outpost for 150 Moroccan troops would be built in Israeli-controlled territory as part of a planned international stabilization force.

top.title: Danube drought forces Hungary, Romania to dim cities and cut power
top.description: Nuclear plants hobbled by record-low river levels have triggered the region's worst energy crisis in decades, with factories halting production.

top.title: US intel warns Putin may test NATO with limited attack
top.description: Lithuania disclosed intelligence on a potential Russian false-flag drone operation in the Baltics the same day the assessment surfaced.

top.title: AI power swings are breaking data center equipment, report finds
top.description: A Bloomberg investigation found rapid GPU power fluctuations are cracking turbines, destroying batteries, and threatening grid stability worldwide.

top.title: Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO to focus on AGI
top.description: Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over as head of Google DeepMind while Jeff Dean departs after 27 years at the company.

top.title: Kim Yo Jong warns of military response to Japan's first Tomahawk test
top.description: North Korea vowed "additional military options" against Japan after Tokyo test-fired a U.S.-made Tomahawk cruise missile for the first time.

top.title: SpaceX posts $7.8B in Q2 revenue in first report since IPO
top.description: The 92% year-over-year jump exceeded Wall Street estimates by nearly $1 billion, driven by Starlink and AI computing growth.

top.title: EU says it 'passed the test' after Ceuta migrant crisis
top.description: Migration Commissioner Magnus Brunner said Tuesday the bloc proved its border resilience after roughly 50,000 people crossed into Spain's North African enclave last week.

top.title: Zelensky dismisses Ukraine's ambassador to the US amid sweeping reshuffle
top.description: Olha Stefanishyna's departure leaves Kyiv without a named envoy in Washington as it lobbies for Patriot missiles and expanded military aid.

top.title: Amazon surpasses $3 trillion market cap for first time
top.description: The e-commerce and cloud giant becomes only the fifth company to reach the milestone, driven by AI optimism and strong AWS growth.

top.title: Ceuta residents force far-right leaders out amid migration crisis
top.description: Counterprotesters chanted "Get out" and surrounded rallies until police escorted far-right figures to the port Saturday evening.

top.title: UN condemns Israeli demolitions in south Lebanon despite ceasefire
top.description: Saturday's statement cited "devastating impact on civilian infrastructure" a day after 700 tonnes of explosives were used near a UNESCO-listed castle.

top.title: Qatari LNG tanker struck in Hormuz days after shipments resumed
top.description: The attack on the Gaslog Shanghai threatens to derail Qatar's fragile resumption of deliveries through the contested strait.

top.title: West Bank settler violence hits record high, UN warns
top.description: Palestinian village watch groups are multiplying as settler reprisal attacks surge following a deadly clash that killed six in the village of Tal.

top.title: US embassies urge Americans to leave Middle East amid Iran escalation
top.description: Coordinated alerts from Cairo to Baghdad warn of "unforeseen escalation" and advise citizens to prepare for departure as hostilities intensify.

top.title: Lithuanian embassy in Kyiv damaged in Russian missile attack
top.description: Lithuania is summoning Russia's representative to protest after missiles landed metres from its Kyiv embassy during an overnight barrage that killed nine.

top.title: OpenAI demos 'Astra' multi-agent AI model for regulators
top.description: CEO Sam Altman traveled to Washington this week to give federal regulators a closed-door look at the new model series before its public release.

top.title: Iran vows to strike US, Israeli energy sites if attacked
top.description: Tehran warned it has comprehensive retaliatory plans ready as reports say U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran could begin this weekend.

top.title: Pentagon gives up leadership of Ukraine aid command
top.description: The U.S. is handing control of a key NATO group coordinating weapons and training for Ukraine to a European or Canadian ally.

top.title: Tanker disabled by projectile near Strait of Hormuz
top.description: An unknown projectile struck a tanker off Oman's coast, damaging its engine room amid escalating U.S.-Iran tensions over the strategic waterway.

top.title: Anthropic says Claude AI models hacked three companies during tests
top.description: A misconfigured testing environment let three Claude models reach the internet and compromise real organizations using basic hacking techniques, the company said.

top.title: Trump walks back Patriot missile license promise to Ukraine
top.description: Days after Zelenskyy said Trump agreed to let Ukraine produce Patriot interceptors, the president said no decision has been made.

top.title: Saudi Arabia launches 14-nation maritime coalition to guard Red Sea shipping
top.description: The alliance aims to counter Houthi attacks disrupting trade through the Bab al-Mandab Strait, with Saudi Arabia hosting the headquarters.

top.title: Gulf states turn to China to pressure Iran on Hormuz
top.description: Frustrated by the limits of U.S. military power, Gulf Arab capitals are testing whether Beijing's economic leverage can reopen vital shipping lanes.

top.title: Boeing reportedly blocking Ukraine's Patriot missile plans
top.description: The aerospace giant's refusal to license seeker head technology could undermine Trump's pledge to let Ukraine produce PAC-3 interceptors.

top.title: Egypt confirms drone attack on LNG vessels at Damietta Port
top.description: The Egyptian Cabinet said Thursday that a drone caused fires on two tankers, including the U.S.-owned Energos Winter, as Trump vowed a "very hard" response.

top.title: IBM says quantum computers now outperform classical systems with verifiable results
top.description: Three papers detail computations beyond classical reach, including a 70-logical-qubit task completed in 15 minutes that classical methods cannot replicate.

top.title: Trump says he'd be 'disappointed' if China arms Iran
top.description: The president said he takes Xi Jinping at his word after Reuters reported Iran expects 400 Chinese-made missile launchers within weeks.

top.title: Iran weighed missile strike on Ukraine before diplomacy defused crisis, NYT reports
top.description: Tehran discussed firing a ballistic missile at a Ukrainian Black Sea port after a drone strike killed an Iranian sailor in the Caspian Sea.

top.title: Russia charges Telegram founder Durov with terrorism
top.description: The FSB issued an international arrest warrant for Durov, accusing him of failing to remove channels used by Ukrainian intelligence.

top.title: Trump says he's 'looking at controls' on AI after OpenAI breach
top.description: More than 1,200 AI lab employees also signed a letter calling on Washington to build tools for slowing development if needed.

top.title: SK Hynix posts record Q2 profit but misses estimates
top.description: The memory chipmaker's 557% operating profit surge still fell short of consensus, as long-term HBM contracts limited gains from rising spot prices.

top.title: Merz pushes for hundreds of billions in EU budget cuts
top.description: Germany's chancellor reiterated demands for deep reductions to the nearly €2 trillion EU spending plan during talks with Irish PM Martin in Dublin.

top.title: Iran set to receive Chinese missiles despite Xi's pledge to Trump, Reuters reports
top.description: The deal for up to 400 shoulder-fired air defense systems would contradict assurances Xi Jinping personally gave Trump that China would not arm Iran.

top.title: China vows countermeasures over US AI distillation sanctions threat
top.description: Beijing accused Washington of "AI hegemonism" on Monday, warning of retaliation as Kimi K3's open weights are set for public release.

top.title: CXMT surges nearly 500% in Shanghai debut after Asia's biggest IPO of 2026
top.description: China's top DRAM chipmaker became the most valuable listed company on the mainland after raising $8.6 billion in a record offering.

top.title: Zelensky hails 'good meeting' with Trump on Patriot production, peace efforts
top.description: The Ukrainian president said they discussed licensing for domestic Patriot missile production and the need to reinvigorate diplomacy with Russia.

top.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot dead after manhunt
top.description: Abdul Ballout, 21, was killed by police Sunday after a van-ramming at Berlin's Pride celebration left one woman dead and 29 injured.

top.title: Gaza death toll tops 73,300 as strikes persist despite ceasefire
top.description: Health officials report 1,191 Palestinians killed since the October 2025 ceasefire, with the UN condemning intensifying Israeli attacks.

top.title: Zelensky says Ukraine will build drone factory in the US
top.description: The announcement follows a bilateral agreement for Ukraine to export combat drones for Pentagon testing and a planned Trump meeting Monday.

top.title: U.S. intel finds Iran's new leader more open to nuclear weapons
top.description: A New York Times report says intelligence agencies concluded Mojtaba Khamenei is less opposed to pursuing a bomb than his late father was.

top.title: Paramount agrees to months-long freeze on Warner Bros. merger
top.description: Twelve state attorneys general secured a standstill that could last until June 2027 and cost Paramount billions in delay fees.

top.title: ICC members vote to dismiss Prosecutor Karim Khan over sexual misconduct
top.description: The secret ballot at U.N. headquarters in New York marks the first time a sitting ICC prosecutor has been removed from office.

top.title: Trump threatens trade probe after EU fines Google $1B
top.description: The president announced a Section 301 investigation after Brussels imposed its first Digital Markets Act penalty on the tech giant.

top.title: Bahrain and Kuwait secretly struck Iran, WSJ reports
top.description: The two Gulf monarchies launched their first direct airstrikes on Iranian military sites, with UAE providing intelligence and air cover, according to the Journal.

top.title: Hugging Face used Chinese AI model to repel autonomous OpenAI cyberattack
top.description: OpenAI admitted its models autonomously breached Hugging Face, which turned to China's open-weight GLM 5.2 after U.S. model guardrails blocked its defense.

top.title: EU adopts largest sanctions package in four years, targeting Russian crypto and banks
top.description: The 21st package includes transaction bans on 14 crypto platforms, asset freezes on 94 Russian banks, and a freeze on the oil price cap.

top.title: Trump says frozen Iranian assets will cover Gulf ship damage
top.description: The president posted on Truth Social that U.S.-held Iranian funds will pay for any damage to ships and cargo in the region.

top.title: UK vows defense after Iran declares bases a target
top.description: Britain said its armed forces are "ready 24/7" after Iran's IRGC warned that any UK base used by the US to strike Iran is a "legitimate target."

top.title: Ukraine's new military chief vows to intensify strikes inside Russia
top.description: Mykhailo Drapatyi assumed command on Wednesday after Zelenskyy dismissed Syrskyi following days of nationwide protests.

top.title: Trump ties Saudi nuclear deal to Abraham Accords
top.description: The president said the agreement signed Wednesday is "totally subject" to Riyadh normalizing relations with Israel.

top.title: Epstein-linked modeling scout Daniel Siad found dead near Paris
top.description: Siad, 69, was under investigation in France for alleged human trafficking and rape tied to the Epstein case.

top.title: Iran rebuilt missile sites faster than expected, WSJ reports
top.description: Satellite imagery and military analysts show Tehran restored underground facilities and continued strikes despite US claims of severe degradation.

top.title: Kuwait summons Iran's ambassador after fourth day of strikes on water plants
top.description: Fires broke out at multiple power and desalination facilities Monday as Iran's attacks threaten drinking water supplies amid extreme heat.

top.title: Trump announces 100% tariff on generic drugs starting August 2028
top.description: Imported generics will remain tariff-free for two years before facing a 100% duty, then 200% — a bid to onshore production of drugs that fill over 90% of U.S. prescriptions.

top.title: Opposition leader Gandhi detained at protest outside Modi's residence
top.description: Delhi Police forcibly removed and detained opposition leaders staging a sit-in over police action against students protesting the NEET paper leak.

top.title: 144 migrants dead or missing off Mauritania, UN says
top.description: One boat drifted for 25 days after leaving The Gambia for Spain's Canary Islands, with only 38 of 181 passengers surviving.

top.title: Iran denies nuclear activity at Pickaxe Mountain after Trump strike threat
top.description: Tehran called U.S. focus on the underground site "a fabricated pretext for aggression" one day after Trump vowed to hit it "pretty soon."

top.title: France bans social media for children under 15
top.description: Parliament approved the landmark bill Tuesday, making France the first European country to restrict minors' access to social platforms.

top.title: Ortega declares Nicaragua will never hold elections again
top.description: The 80-year-old president made the announcement during a speech marking the 47th anniversary of the Sandinista revolution on Sunday.

top.title: Trump wants FIFA's Infantino as next UN chief
top.description: The proposal follows their close alliance during the 2026 World Cup, where the two handed Spain the trophy on July 19.

top.title: Hamas elects chief negotiator al-Hayya as new leader
top.description: The group's top ceasefire negotiator replaces Yahya Sinwar, who was killed by Israeli forces in October 2024, after a months-long internal vote.

top.title: Andy Burnham takes office as UK prime minister
top.description: The former Greater Manchester mayor succeeds Keir Starmer, pledging to "rewire" Britain with a focus on devolution and cost-of-living relief.

top.title: Lebanon's Aoun to meet Trump to press for Israeli withdrawal
top.description: The first White House visit by a Lebanese president in nearly 20 years centers on securing Israel's pullback from southern Lebanon.

top.title: Spain wins 2026 World Cup with extra-time goal over Argentina
top.description: Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute to give Spain a 1-0 victory over Argentina at MetLife Stadium in the final.

top.title: Tate brothers arrested in Miami on UK extradition request
top.description: British prosecutors authorized 38 new charges, bringing the total to 59 across both brothers, including rape, trafficking and indecent images of a child.

top.title: Israel says Iran moved centrifuges into Pickaxe Mountain
top.description: The intelligence was shared with the U.S. as Trump weighs strikes on the fortified underground nuclear site near Natanz.

top.title: Venezuela earthquake death toll passes 5,100 as IMF funds flow to rebuilding
top.description: The twin 7.2 and 7.5 magnitude quakes on June 24 have left nearly 20,000 homeless, with the country securing $346 million from the IMF for reconstruction.

top.title: Iran's reclusive new leader may speak with Putin first, TASS reports
top.description: Mojtaba Khamenei has not appeared publicly since succeeding his father in March and will stay hidden for security reasons, an Iranian source said.

top.title: New UK PM Burnham speaks with Trump on defense, Hormuz
top.description: Hours after taking office Monday, Burnham congratulated Trump on the World Cup and pledged UK commitment to securing the Strait of Hormuz.

top.title: Israel advances 1,024 new settlement units in West Bank
top.description: The Palestinian Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said nine settlement plans have been advanced since early July, targeting over 1,069 dunams of land.

top.title: Iraq, Syria sign US-backed deal to revive oil pipeline bypassing Hormuz
top.description: The $60 billion package of agreements includes rehabilitating the Kirkuk-Baniyas corridor to carry 2 million barrels per day to the Mediterranean.

top.title: Khamenei calls Trump's signature 'worthless' as US-Iran MoU collapses
top.description: Iran's supreme leader warned of "unforgettable lessons" as the U.S. announced its first troop deaths from direct Iranian fire and a seventh night of strikes.

top.title: Israel destroys 3 more schools in southern Lebanon
top.description: Lebanon's education minister says Israeli forces looted and demolished three schools, bringing the total destroyed to 20.

top.title: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake hits Mexico's Chiapas coast, triggering tsunami warning
top.description: The shallow quake struck near Puerto Madero on Friday, shaking buildings as far as Guatemala City and El Salvador.

top.title: Andy Burnham becomes Labour leader, set to be PM
top.description: Burnham ran unopposed after securing support from 379 of 403 Labour MPs, following Keir Starmer's resignation last month.

top.title: Luggage maker's filing pegs DeepSeek valuation at about $52B
top.description: A routine disclosure by Shenzhen-listed Korrun revealed its subsidiary's indirect stake in DeepSeek, implying a valuation of roughly 351 billion yuan.

top.title: UN warns Cuba blackouts deepening humanitarian crisis
top.description: The UN said repeated nationwide outages are disrupting health services, clean water and economic activity across the island.

top.title: Argentina beat England 2-1 to reach World Cup final
top.description: Lautaro Martínez's stoppage-time goal sent the defending champions past England and into Sunday's final against Spain.

top.title: TSMC profit surges 77% to record as AI demand booms
top.description: Diluted EPS of NT$27.25 beat Wall Street estimates by a wide margin, marking a fifth straight quarter of record earnings.

top.title: Pew survey: China viewed more favorably than US worldwide
top.description: A companion report released Wednesday shows confidence in Xi Jinping now exceeds confidence in Trump in 22 countries surveyed.

top.title: CIA says AI drones give Russian troops only minutes to survive on front lines
top.description: Director Ratcliffe's disclosure comes as Ukraine expands its drone war to the Black Sea, striking 20 Russian vessels overnight.

top.title: SpaceX stock falls below $135 IPO price for first time
top.description: Shares have dropped roughly 40% from their post-listing peak near $225, just over a month after the largest IPO in U.S. history.

top.title: China's Q2 GDP growth hits 3.5-year low as credit misses
top.description: Weak lending data and 4.3% second-quarter growth have intensified pressure on Beijing to ramp up fiscal stimulus measures.

top.title: Lithuania says Russia planning attacks on infrastructure
top.description: President Nauseda cited intelligence reports warning of potential Russian strikes on energy and communications sites across the Baltic region.

top.title: Mexico files criminal complaints in U.S. over 17 migrant deaths
top.description: The government escalated from diplomacy to legal action, submitting filings to U.S. prosecutors over deaths in ICE custody and during enforcement raids.

top.title: OpenAI's first device is a screenless smart speaker with cameras, Bloomberg reports
top.description: The portable home companion, designed with Jony Ive, is expected to be unveiled later this year and released in 2027.

top.title: Spain beats France 2-0 to reach 2026 World Cup final
top.description: Goals from Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro sealed a dominant semifinal win in Dallas, sending Spain to their first World Cup final since 2010.

top.title: UAE frees 55 Iranian fishermen amid Gulf war tensions
top.description: The rare diplomatic gesture comes as U.S. strikes on Iran continue and Tehran attacks tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

top.title: Nine European nations form missile defense coalition with Ukraine
top.description: The alliance, announced Monday in Paris, will develop the Freya interceptor system as a cheaper alternative to the Patriot.
